jobs.title: Responsable Réadaptation en Urgence
jobs.description: Handicap International / Humanité & Inclusion (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et vulnérabilisées, elle agit et témoigne pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels et améliorer leurs conditions de vie. Elle s’engage à promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Depuis sa création en 1982, HI a mis en place des programmes de développement dans plus de 60 pays et intervient dans de nombreuses situations d’urgence. Aujourd'hui, nous avons un budget d'environ 255 millions d'euros, avec 4794 employés dans le monde. Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens. CONTEXTE : La Direction des Programmes Internationaux (DPI) de Humanité & Inclusion comprend entre autres 5 Directions Géographiques, 4 Directions Techniques, 1 Direction Atlas Logistique et 1 Direction Urgence. La Direction Urgence est composée de 15 personnes: une équipe en charge de la veille, de l'alerte et de la préparation aux urgences et une équipe en charge des interventions d'urgence au niveau du siège et sur le terrain. C’est au sein de cette dernière, composée de 6 spécialistes des urgences et prêts à être déployés sous 72 heures que nous recrutons un ou une Responsable Réadaptation physique et Fonctionnelle en Urgence dans le cadre d’un remplacement temporaire. OBJECTIFS DU POSTE : Sous la responsabilité du responsable du pool d'urgence et en étroite coordination avec les Spécialistes en Réadaptation Physique et Fonctionnelle du siège, le responsable Réada

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK. Role Summary PLOS is a nonprofit Open Access publisher with an ambitious mission: to help transform research communication so that science can be shared, understood and used more effectively.  Research publishing is changing rapidly. Researchers expectations are changing. Technology is creating possibilities that didn t exist a few years ago. And at PLOS we re rethinking some of the services, systems and assumptions that have shaped scholarly publishing for decades.   That means there are interesting product  problems  to solve - not just features to deliver.   You ll take responsibility for a product area and work with designers, engineers and colleagues across PLOS to understand the problems that matter, work out where we can make the greatest difference and help the team learn its way towards good solutions.   You ll be joining active product teams working on significant problems and will have plenty of opportunity to shape what we do and how we do it.     How we work   We want our product teams to be curious, evidence-led and comfortable with uncertainty.   We don t expect a Product Manager to arrive with all the answers. We do expect them to ask good questions.   You ll use continuous discovery alongside delivery: spending time with users, looking at data, understanding the wider service, identifying assumptions and finding practical ways to test them.   You ll help the team break large problems into smaller things we can learn from, rather than waiting until everything is known before we release something.   And you ll make the team s thinking visible - explaining what we re trying to achieve, what we ve learned, what we re uncertain about and why we re making the choice

jobs.title: QC Inspector (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Mission Brief  As QC Inspector, you are responsible for verifying that incoming materials, manufactured parts, assemblies, and released products conform to drawings, specifications, workmanship standards, and quality requirements. You will perform dimensional and visual inspections, review supplier documentation, record objective evidence, and support reliable conformity decisions throughout incoming and final inspection. This role is critical to protecting product quality and production continuity. You will work closely with Incoming Inspection, Production, Metrology, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, and Product Assurance to identify non-conformances, improve inspection methods, and ensure only compliant hardware progresses through the manufacturing flow. Your Role in Our Space Mission:  Perform incoming and final inspections of parts, materials, assemblies, and associated documentation against approved drawings, specifications, and inspection plans. Conduct dimensional inspections using hand gauges, measurement equipment, microscopes, and coordinate measurement systems as applicable. Perform visual and workmanship inspections, including verification of surface condition, coating, cleaning, marking, damage, and assembly quality. Review certificates of conformity, inspection reports, material certificates, and other supplier quality documentation for completeness and compliance. Record inspection results and maintain accurate, traceable quality and product acceptance documentation. Identify, segregate, and report non-conforming products and support technical clarification, containment, and disposition activities. Create and improve inspection checklists, measurement plans, and inspection instructions for incoming and final inspection. Develop and optimize measurement programs using applicable metrology software and equipment. Support supplier quality requests, source-related investigations, and supplier qualification activities with inspection

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY. The Role You'll be a player-coach engineering leader with a spike in technical strategy, you'll own engineering delivery for your team end-to-end - from developing exceptional engineers to solving some of our most difficult engineering problems & setting technical direction. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll spend roughly 20% of your time contributing code and 80% leading your team, with that ratio shifting as we scale. jobs.description: DeleteMe is the leader in proactive privacy protection. We help Individuals, Families, Businesses and Security teams reduce their human attack surface by continuously monitoring and removing exposed personal data (PII) from the open web — the very data threat actors use to launch social engineering, phishing, Gen-AI deepfake, doxxing campaigns, physical threats, and identity fraud. Operating as a fast-growing, global SaaS company, DeleteMe serves both consumers and enterprises. DeleteMe has completed over 100 million opt-out removals, helping customers reduce risks associated with identity theft, spam, doxxing, and other cybersecurity threats. We deliver detailed privacy reports, continuous monitoring, and expert support to ensure ongoing protection. DeleteMe acts as a scalable, managed defense layer for your most vulnerable attack vector: your people. That’s why 30% of the Fortune 100 , top tech firms, major banks, federal agencies, and U.S. states rely on DeleteMe to protect their workforce. DeleteMe is led by a passionate and experienced team and driven by a powerful mission to empower consumers with privacy. I bring the ideas, the network and the money — you turn them into real products, pages, campaigns and processes. You build and test the way we always do it: build a sellable prototype (CHF 100–1,000), test it on the market with Facebook ads (CHF 5,000–10,000), build the product fully (CHF 10,000–20,000), then launch with real marketing spend. MyBikePlan is the proof: 2019 idea, one-week website, one week of Facebook marketing, CHF 500 invested → 30 pre-orders. 2020 launch with CHF 1M in the first year, 2021 team, 2025 sold close to CHF 20M. The playbook is set — you run it on new projects. Current projects: Fairbroker.ch (AI insurance broker, market test now, live Q1 2027), a kettlebell workout app (52-card deck, early prototype, suppliers in China secured), and Glanzio (B2B store-window cleaning, launch test Q1 2027). jobs.description: PT Pamapersada Nusantara (PAMA) adalah bagian dari Astra Heavy Equipment, Mining, Construction & Energy yang telah menjadi pionir dalam dunia kontraktor pertambangan dengan pangsa pasar terbesar di Indonesia. Rekrutmen PT Pamapersada Nusantara (PAMA). PAMA melayani berbagai klien dari bisnis pertambangan untuk menghasilkan produk pertambangan dan energi dengan selalu berkomitmen terhadap prinsip ESG dan mengedepankan aspek kontinuitas serta keberlanjutan sebagai tujuan utama. Untuk itu, PAMA terus tumbuh dengan cepat dan menciptakan inovasi berkesinambungan secara konsisten. Saat ini, PAMA mengajak talenta-talenta baru untuk bergabung dan berkembang bersama dalam menjawab tantangan dunia pertambangan. Kantor Pusat PT Pamapersada Nusantara di Jl.Rawagelam I No. 9, Kawasan Industri Pulogadung, Jakarta 13930, Indonesia Rekrutmen PT Pamapersada Nusantara (PAMA) Saat ini PT Pamapersada Nusantara (PAMA) membuka rekrutmen untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: Fresh Graduate Development Program (FGDP) 1. Management Development Officer Uraian Pekerjaan: Memfasilitasi Project Management dalam rangka penyusunan rencana kerja strategis, operasional dan target, memastikan implementasi dan memonitor pelaksanaannnya. Mendukung organisasi dalam rangka pelaksanaan sistem manajemen mutu maupun pelaksanaan strategic improvement site Memfasilitasi Project Management dalam pelaksanaan tinjauan dan evaluasi terhadap semua perencanaan kerja dan pencapaian kinerja Memfasilitasi pelaksanaan Plan-Do-Check-Action organisasi secara close loop. General Requirement: Sudah menyelesaikan studi IPK minimal 3.00 Tidak buta warna Bersedia ditempatkan disemua area kerja job site PAMA Belum pernah mengikuti proses seleksi di PAMA selama 1 tahun terakhir Bersedia mematuhi seluruh persyaratan perundang-undangan, peraturan perusahaan, dan persyaratan lainnya terkait dengan keselamatan kesehatan kerja, keselamatan operasi, dan lingkungan hidup Specific Requirement: Pendidikan S1 Juru
